Our graph based parser when operating offline, achieves state-of-the-art performance on parsing on both datasets. The LM complete model also achieves nontrivial BLEU gain compared with the simple baseline of node completion. Now, let's look at the prediction accuracy of our prefix to graph parser.

Schauen wir uns nun die Vorhersagegenauigkeit unseres Präfixes für den Graph-Parser an.
